text: Debugging is a crucial skill for any programmer. Finding a bug is often the hardest part, especially when your code seems perfect. To tackle this, a systematic approach is essential instead of making random changes. Start by reading error messages carefully; they often point directly to the problem. Use debugging tools, like breakpoints in your IDE, to pause the program and inspect variable values step by step. Additionally, logging is a powerful technique. Print out messages to the console to track the flow of execution and see where things go wrong. By following a clear plan and using these tools, you can isolate the issue and fix it efficiently, making the process far less frustrating.
